as_told.title: Luminous object paces AVCO Mark V re-entry vehicle test

plain: During a 1962 missile test from Cape Canaveral, an unknown object is said to have appeared right beside the reentry vehicle, the cone that carries a warhead back down through the atmosphere. Michels describes the test film himself: "At the 4 minute and 40 second mark in the video, an object appears to phase itself into existence alongside the re-entry vehicle". He says this happened while the vehicle was travelling at 20,000 feet per second, or Mach 18. He credits a US Air Force and NASA report written after the flight. A former Senate staffer named Kurt McConnell tells it separately. He names the vehicle as the Mark V, built by the defense company AVCO, and dates the test to 19 September 1962. He says the official report to the Defense Department states "objects of unknown origin and identity were tracking or pacing" it. Neither teller quotes the report beyond that phrase. If true, something unknown kept pace with one of the fastest objects of its day, and the military wrote it down.
